name: KeyValuePair
purpose: Map a descriptive label to a static or inline-editable value for scannable metadata presentation.
intent: Present metadata as label/value rows using semantic <dt>/<dd> elements. Supports both static text values and inline-editable controls (TextField/TextArea/Select with appearance='inline'). Grouped as a molecule because it composes text controls for its inline-editable mode.

figmaSource.note: 22 variants across size (sm/md/lg), context (default/inline), and underline axes. The context=inline variant maps to embedding a TextField/TextArea with appearance='inline'.
apiAdaptationNotes: Figma's context=default renders a static text value; context=inline renders an inline-editable control. In code, this is controlled by passing children (an inline-editable control) vs. a plain value prop - no explicit context prop needed.
The key (label) uses <dt> and the value uses <dd> for semantic HTML, expecting the parent Key Value List to render a <dl>.
Key width is a fixed 40% (inline-size: 40%) at all sizes, matching the Figma layout.
Gap between key and value is --spacing-lg at all sizes.
Underline is a simple bottom border (border-width-sm solid border/default) toggled by a boolean prop.

label.description: The key label displayed in the left column.

value.description: Static value text. Ignored when children is provided.

className.description: Composes with the root element's class list.

children.description: Inline-editable control (TextField/TextArea/Select with appearance='inline'). Takes precedence over value.

anatomy.description: Flex row (align-items: baseline) holding the key and value. Carries the size class and optional underline border.
Label text in the left column (40% width, content/subtle color).
Value text or inline-editable children in the right column (flex: 1 1 auto, content/default color).

accessibility.role: Uses semantic <dt>/<dd> elements inside a <dl> (Key Value List).
accessibility.label: The key (<dt>) provides the label; inline-editable children must provide their own aria-label.
accessibility.structure: Must be wrapped in a Key Value List (<dl>) for screen readers to announce the description list structure.

do: Wrap in a Key Value List (<dl>) for proper semantic structure.
Use appearance='inline' on TextField/TextArea children for inline editing.
Provide aria-label on inline-editable children for accessibility.
Use underline to visually separate pairs in a list.
dont: Don't use for full form layouts - use the Form organism with Field molecules.
Don't pass both value and children expecting both to render - children wins.
Don't use outside a <dl> context - the <dt>/<dd> elements need it for correct semantics.
behaviorNotes: children takes precedence over value when both are provided.
The key occupies a fixed 40% width; the value fills the remaining space.
align-items: baseline keeps the key text and value text (or inline control text) vertically aligned.
knownLimitations: Fixed 40% key width - not configurable per instance.
No built-in validation or error state - inline-editable children manage their own.
